candidates.description: These tokens represent common Thai vowel markers, tone marks, and final consonant clusters found within Thai script typography and text processing.
This vector represents locative and prepositional locators, predominantly focusing on the Thai preposition for "in" or "within" along with related spatial and temporal markers.
These tokens are subword fragments and character n-grams commonly appearing in Thai language text and loanword transliterations.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai text fragments ending with the consonant 'ก' (ko kai).
This vector represents modal verbs, auxiliary markers, and future tense indicators in Thai and English expressing possibility, intent, or condition.
This vector represents sequential integers and numerical counting order.
This feature vector represents common Thai prepositions, conjunctions, and grammatical particles, often related to possession or localization.
This feature vector is related to the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (So Suea) appearing at the end of word tokens or syllables.
This vector activates for Thai consonant letters and character combinations.
This feature vector activates on mixed-script tokens containing both English political/foundational terms and Thai vocabulary.
